_about: Headline Hype v4 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 10 Top-100 refs: drive client r35 + r34, troy_media r42, amrofilms, Vincent r13, kael_media r44, maxmill_ae, jim.malingin x2, tians028; ~/reels/style-train/headline-hype). Bold ad/YouTube-hype energy: the speaker stays in colour with a contrasty warm-red grade; 1-2 word captions in heavy wide ALL CAPS at chest height, white, with ONE keyword per line in red (or a second key colour), a key word stacks big under small lead words; red full-screen word cards, a headline title box in the hook, animated stat cards (bars/counters), logo pops on named platforms, a red X over the myth. Measured: ~17 hard cuts/min (one every ~3.5 s), punch-ins every ~3.6 s between them.

director.style: Headline Hype: a loud, ad-grade talking head. Every line is a headline: 1-2 heavy caps words at chest height, one keyword per line in red. Between the talking, hard-cut graphic beats land on the spoken words: a red word card, a stat that counts up, a platform logo, a red X over the myth. Speaker in colour, contrasty and warm.
director.captions: captions.reds = the 1 word per sentence that carries the claim or the pain (numbers, money, results, 'never', 'reality'). captions.keys = at most 1 positive outcome word per 10 s in yellow. Never mark filler ('cause', 'so', 'like', 'actually') as a key. Uppercase.
director.titlebox: One per video at 0.1-0.3 s: the hook in 2-5 words in the red accent box, held ~3 s (the 'headline box').
director.wordcards: At most 1 wordpage scene per 20 s on bg accent (red field, white words) for the punchiest 2-4 word line; big: the payoff word. 0.5-1.2 s, hard cut in and out.
director.stats: Any number, count or money the speaker says: a big beat with count (counts up) or a popcard ui 'bars' / 'calendar' / 'stopwatch' card. 1-1.6 s.
director.logos: A named platform, tool or company: a logo beat (simple-icons slug) in the slot beside the head, 0.8-1.2 s, pop sound.
director.strike: A myth or 'not X': a strike beat (red cross).
director.cutaways: Optional 1-2 image scenes per 20 s (stock_fetch.py, public domain / CC0) for a concrete place or object; keep colour, contrast up. Never two graphic beats back to back without 0.5 s of speaker.
director.rhythm: Hard cuts (takes + full-screen scenes) about 17/min, never more than ~6 per 20 s; punch-ins every ~3.6 s; overlays (logos, title box, stat cards) don't cut the picture, so prefer them over full-screen scenes. Sound: whoosh on cards, pop on logos, impact on the title and the payoff. Upbeat bed ~20 dB under the voice.
